question: Which of the following languages is NOT a Classical Language of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prakrit**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Prakrit** has not been designated as a classical language by the Government of India.
 
• Hindi is given the status of the official language of the nation by using article 343 of the constitution.
 
• An independent literary tradition and a large and ancient body of written literature are the features of classical language.
